description.text: The sixth expansion of the MEGA series, released on 31 July 2026. Mega Rayquaza ex leads it: when it is played from the hand onto the Bench, its Ability looks at the top four cards of the deck and attaches a basic Energy found among them, and its attack Storm Emeralda does more damage for each Fire and Lightning Energy attached to all of its player's Pokémon. With it came Stadiums printed in two halves, Legendary Summit, Legendary Ocean Trench and Legendary Lava Lake, each put into play as one Stadium when both halves are played together from the hand. Legendary Summit makes either player's Colorless Pokémon give up one fewer Prize card when knocked out by attack damage, so a Mega Rayquaza ex gives up two. Talonflame ex, which can be put onto the Bench straight from the hand while its player has a Colorless Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, Mega Golisopod ex, Wishiwashi ex, Mega Golurk ex, Mega Malamar ex, Raikou ex and Heat Rotom ex join it, with Adventuring Lantern, which takes a basic Fire Energy and a basic Lightning Energy from the deck, the Pokémon Tool Custom Vest, and the Supporters Zinnia's Trust and Aarune. Packs held five cards and no basic Energy, and the official page encouraged sealed play with it. The cards are numbered to 76, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex, Trainer cards and Special Energy, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Rayquaza ex as a Mega Ultra Rare.
